newsitem.title: USA: U.S. EIA resumes semi-monthly winter fuels reports.
newsitem.headline: U.S. EIA resumes semi-monthly winter fuels reports.

text.p: With recent price decreases and barring more long-term severe winter weather, the U.S. Energy Information Administration said Wednesday it will stop issuing residential heating oil and propane prices each week.

The EIA said it will resume its normal semi-monthly cycle of publishing residential heating fuel prices, advising states to resume a semi-monthly price collection cycles for the remainder of the heating season.
Residential heating oil and propane prices are collected by 24 state energy offices that participate with the EIA under an agreement for the winter season, which ends March 17.
The EIA had stepped up its collection and publication of residential heating fuel prices because of price spikes earlier in the season caused partly by tight inventories.
